motion.$description: Durations and easings (D-27). Under prefers-reduced-motion every duration is 0: tokens.css sets each one to 0s there, and components.css also turns transitions and animations off, so nothing a person asked to keep still moves. Marketing animation follows brand/README.md section 10: 0.4 to 1.2 s, ease-out, a static end frame under reduced motion.

fast.$description: A control's state: hover colours, the switch's thumb, a chevron turning. What every transition in components.css uses.

base.$description: Something that moves across the screen in a product: a panel opening, a toast arriving.

slow.$description: Marketing pages: a section's entrance or a diagram drawing itself, inside the 0.4 to 1.2 s band. Never in product chrome.

pulse.$description: One cycle of a loop that says 'still loading' (the skeleton). Slow enough to read as calm, not as an alarm.

standard.$description: CSS's own ease, what the transitions used before this token: product state changes.

out.$description: Fast then settling: things arriving, and marketing animation (brand/README.md section 10 says ease-out).
